title: Disentangle and denoise: Tackling context misalignment for video moment retrieval

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: This paper proposes a cross-modal Context Denoising Network (CDNet) for accurate moment retrieval by disentangling complex correlations and denoising irrelevant dynamics.Specifically, we propose a query-guided semantic disentanglement (QSD) to decouple video moments by estimating alignment levels according to the global and fine-grained correlation.

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: A Context-aware Dynamic Denoisement (CDD) is proposed to enhance understanding of aligned spatial-temporal details by learning a group of query-relevant offsets.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Disentangle and denoise: Tackling context misalignment for video moment retrieval Video Moment Retrieval, which aims to locate in-context video moments according to a natural language query, is an essential task for cross-modal grounding.
